finding: The English arm explains the entire construct and its alternatives; the marked arm is an uninstantiated form heading. This measures documentation-versus-heading length, not paired usage. No allegation of intent; no original arithmetic rewritten.

source_pair.english: Trailing tags on any action instruction. "<ACTION>, idempotent" states the action may be repeated without changing the end state beyond the first execution - English: "it is safe to run twice". "<ACTION>, no-retry" states a repeat would materially change the outcome - English: "run exactly once". On ambiguous completion, idempotent licenses blind retry; no-retry requires verification or escalation first (composing naturally with human_needed(<why>)). Bare instructions stay legal and unmarked; tag when repeatability is load-bearing.
